**ESCALATION #297: guard (c) breaks tip-most cleanup reverter fixtures A2/A6**

**What**: Rev-3 ruling for issue #297/#259 D2-PR3 said to gate the brain-audit reverter-skip exemption with `exempt = isResolvedAt(candidate, auditedTip).resolved && netAddFull(candidate) <= 0`. Implemented experimentally and ran the suite: it makes A8 GREEN and keeps A7 GREEN exactly as the ruling claimed, but it BREAKS two frozen liveness fixtures — D2 A2 and D2 A6 (legitimate tip-most cleanup reverters that must be [SKIP], exit 0). Per hard-constraint, STOPPED and escalated to #297 rather than improvising a doctrine change or weakening a fixture. Tree left clean at the frozen A8-red baseline; no commit, no PR.

**Why**: Structural incompatibility. `netAddFull` deliberately uses a FULL-WINDOW inclusive `[from,to]` range (resolution.mjs firstParentMergesInclusive, design §15.3) so a tip-most cleanup reverter can "see the offender it inverted BEHIND it" and earn its tree-keyed exemption. `isResolvedAt` uses a DIRECTIONAL half-open `(offender, tip]` range (netPresent → firstParentMergesAfter), which is EMPTY for any tip-most merge → netPresent = 1 (base term only) > 0 → resolved:false ALWAYS for a tip-most merge. So gating the reverter exemption on isResolvedAt categorically denies the exemption to EVERY tip-most cleanup reverter — the exact case the reverter-skip exists to serve. Root cause: a tip-most cleanup revert that DELETES a >400-line file (A2) or deletes an ADR (A6) itself fails a tree-keyed check (parseDiffNumstat counts add+del: diff-size-count.mjs:77; adrPresence flags a deleted ADR path: adr-presence.mjs) and today depends on the reverter-skip to become [SKIP]. The guard cannot distinguish "tip-most ADD offender (must fail, A8)" from "tip-most cleanup DELETE (must skip, A2/A6)" because BOTH are directional-resolved=false at the tip.

**Where**: brain/scripts/brain-audit.mjs:376 (exemption site); brain/scripts/governance/postmerge/resolution.mjs (isResolvedAt/netPresent vs netAddFull range asymmetry); brain/scripts/brain-audit.test.mjs (A2 line 542, A6 line 566, A7 line 417, A8 line 785); brain/scripts/vcs/diff-size-count.mjs:77.

**Learned**: Empirical A2 failure output: `[FAIL] R: revert O — diffSize: diff size 500 lines exceeds budget of 400` + `[FAIL-SHA]` → exit 1 (expected exit 0, O correctly [SKIP] resolved by revert). The ruling text only asserted A7-green/A8-green; it did not address A2/A6, which the composition breaks. This is a reviewer-level doctrine conflict — NOT for the patch-author to resolve.
